name: native-shapes
description: Actual Rust generic parsers and impl Iterator behind Box<dyn CursorOps>, returning Either String (Maybe Int) to PureScript.

cases.reason: Ordinary Effect client uses native generic/trait-object iteration and explicit destruction.
Aliases and replay remain ordinary PureScript; the wrapper controls consumption dynamically.
A deferred Effect can keep the native cursor alive; no static region confinement is claimed.
Opaque Cursor cannot be safely coerced to its native contents.
Raw branch translation is hidden behind the typed public next operation.
No public Cursor constructor permits forging a handle.
